purpose: Keep repository root clean by separating installable update transports from non-installable source rollups and snapshots.

behavior.sidecar: If .sha256 or .sha256.txt is present, verify before classification and move it with the archive.
behavior.rootAudit: Root audit remains strict and side-effect free; classification happens before it.

rationale: A source rollup is a recovery/new-folder handoff, not a patch installer. Dropping one into the live repository root must not be mistaken for source authority or poison Full Gate cleanliness.
